history.text: France accepts the current public package: attributed consultation summaries and a consolidated note. This format is within our fictional mandate and leaves the official mandate and review deadlines untouched.

The United Kingdom accepts the current package of published attributed consultation summaries and a consolidated note. It is within our fictional mandate and leaves the official mandate and review deadlines untouched.

Japan accepts the current closed package: attributed summaries sent only to participants, with no consolidated note published. This is within our fictional mandate and leaves the official mandate and review deadlines untouched.

Ghana accepts the current closed package: attributed summaries sent only to participants, with no consolidated note published. This is within our fictional mandate and leaves the official mandate and review deadlines untouched.

The United Arab Emirates accepts the current closed package: attributed summaries sent only to participants, with no consolidated note published. This falls within our fictional mandate and leaves the official mandate and review deadlines untouched.

Every package has a checked rejection in the public record: public by GHA, aggregate by GBR, hybrid by ARE, and closed by FRA. The workshop therefore records an impasse, leaving the official mandate and review deadlines untouched.

options.public: Publish attributed consultation summaries and a consolidated note.
options.aggregate: Publish only a consolidated note with no attributed submissions.
options.hybrid: Publish a consolidated note and send an attributed annex to the consultation participants only.
options.closed: Send attributed summaries to participants only and publish no consolidated note.
